title: AutoVance

listing.shortDescription: An AI-themed workflow automation platform — animated landing experience, a React Flow workflow editor, and webhook, cron and email plumbing.
listing.fullDescription: AutoVance packages business-process automation with an AI narrative. The landing page sells the story with a typing headline and particle canvas, while the app behind it gets concrete: a React Flow workflow editor, dashboard, cron and webhook endpoints, email automation, team pages and login. Next.js 13 keeps it all in one deployable app.

closing.conclusion: AutoVance showed how far a landing page plus workflow tooling can go: AI-themed marketing, a React Flow workflow editor, and webhook, cron and email plumbing in one app.
